sql:
INSERT INTO case_resource_links(id,preparation_id,case_id,run_id,owner_id,park_id,org_id,combination_id,revision,preparation_revision,preparation_sha256,service_id,service_version,reason,snapshot,actor_id,request_key,fingerprint)
      VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING *
INSERT INTO dispatch_notice_outbox(event_id,recipient_id) VALUES(%s,%s)
INSERT INTO preparation_events(id,preparation_id,actor_id,request_key,fingerprint,revision,action,payload) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
INSERT INTO preparation_evidence(id,preparation_id,slot,version,text,source_kind,source_label,source_sha256,actor_id,authenticity) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'UNVERIFIED') RETURNING *
INSERT INTO resource_case_claims(combination_id,case_id,owner_id,park_id,org_id) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO service_dispatch_events(id,dispatch_id,offer_id,actor_id,request_key,fingerprint,revision,action,payload) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
INSERT INTO service_dispatch_offers(id,dispatch_id,executor_id,preparation_revision,preparation_sha256,reason,state) VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'OFFERED') RETURNING *
INSERT INTO service_dispatches(id,preparation_id,revision,current_offer_id) VALUES(%s,%s,1,%s) RETURNING *
INSERT INTO synthetic_resource_combination_members VALUES(%s,%s)
INSERT INTO synthetic_resource_combination_receipts VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
INSERT INTO synthetic_resource_combinations VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,'CONFIRMED',%s) RETURNING *

INSERT INTO synthetic_resource_holds(id,resource_id,principal_id,park_id,org_id,
                resource_revision,starts_at,ends_at,quantity,buffer_seconds,purpose,state,created_at,expires_at,namespace)
                VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,'HELD',%s,%s,'SYNTHETIC') RETURNING *
INSERT INTO synthetic_resource_receipts VALUES(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
SELECT * FROM case_resource_links WHERE actor_id=%s AND request_key=%s
SELECT * FROM case_resource_links WHERE case_id=%s AND owner_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s ORDER BY revision
SELECT * FROM case_resource_links WHERE case_id=%s AND owner_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM controlled_plans WHERE preparation_id=%s FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM preparation_catalog WHERE park_id=%s AND service_id=%s AND version=%s
SELECT * FROM preparation_events WHERE actor_id=%s AND request_key=%s
SELECT * FROM preparations WHERE id=%s
SELECT * FROM preparations WHERE id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM preparations WHERE id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM principals WHERE id=%s AND active
SELECT * FROM principals WHERE id=%s AND active AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s
SELECT * FROM principals WHERE token_hash=%s AND active
SELECT * FROM run_assignments WHERE principal_id=%s AND run_id=%s
SELECT * FROM runs WHERE id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s
SELECT * FROM service_dispatch_events WHERE actor_id=%s AND request_key=%s
SELECT * FROM service_dispatch_offers WHERE id=%s
SELECT * FROM service_dispatches WHERE preparation_id=%s FOR SHARE
SELECT * FROM service_dispatches WHERE preparation_id=%s FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM service_receipt_steps WHERE id=%s AND preparation_id=%s
SELECT * FROM synthetic_resource_combinations WHERE id=%s AND principal_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s
SELECT * FROM synthetic_resource_combinations WHERE id=%s AND principal_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM synthetic_resources WHERE id=%s AND park_id=%s
SELECT 1 FROM capability_grants WHERE principal_id=%s AND capability=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s AND active
SELECT 1 FROM preparation_events WHERE preparation_id=%s AND action='DECLARE_FACT_PURPOSE' LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM preparation_grants WHERE principal_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s AND capability=%s AND active
SELECT 1 FROM service_dispatch_offers o JOIN service_dispatches d ON d.id=o.dispatch_id WHERE d.preparation_id=%s AND o.executor_id=%s
SELECT 1 FROM service_receipt_steps WHERE preparation_id=%s
SELECT 1 FROM service_receipt_steps WHERE preparation_id=%s AND preparation_revision=%s
SELECT 1 FROM synthetic_resource_grants WHERE principal_id=%s AND resource_id=%s AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s AND capability=%s AND active
SELECT DISTINCT ON(slot) id,slot,version,text,source_kind,source_label,source_sha256,authenticity FROM preparation_evidence WHERE preparation_id=%s ORDER BY slot,version DESC
SELECT case_id FROM resource_case_claims WHERE combination_id=%s
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS now

SELECT e.id event_id,e.dispatch_id,e.offer_id,e.actor_id,e.revision,e.action,e.created_at,
       d.preparation_id,o.executor_id FROM service_dispatch_events e
       JOIN service_dispatches d ON d.id=e.dispatch_id JOIN service_dispatch_offers o ON o.id=e.offer_id
       WHERE e.id=%s
SELECT e.revision,e.action,e.payload,e.created_at FROM service_dispatch_events e JOIN service_dispatch_offers o ON o.id=e.offer_id WHERE e.dispatch_id=%s AND o.executor_id=%s ORDER BY e.revision
SELECT e.revision,e.action,e.payload,e.created_at FROM service_dispatch_events e JOIN service_dispatch_offers o ON o.id=e.offer_id WHERE e.dispatch_id=%s ORDER BY e.revision

SELECT h.*,m.combination_id,r.name AS resource_name FROM synthetic_resource_holds h JOIN synthetic_resources r ON r.id=h.resource_id LEFT JOIN synthetic_resource_combination_members m ON m.hold_id=h.id WHERE h.id=%s AND h.principal_id=%s AND h.park_id=%s AND h.org_id=%s

SELECT h.*,m.combination_id,r.name AS resource_name FROM synthetic_resource_holds h JOIN synthetic_resources r ON r.id=h.resource_id LEFT JOIN synthetic_resource_combination_members m ON m.hold_id=h.id WHERE h.id=%s AND h.principal_id=%s AND h.park_id=%s AND h.org_id=%s FOR UPDATE OF h
SELECT hold_id FROM synthetic_resource_combination_members WHERE combination_id=%s ORDER BY hold_id
SELECT id,park_id,org_id,role,active,xmin::text AS generation FROM principals WHERE id=ANY(%s) AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s ORDER BY id
SELECT id,payload,created_at FROM preparation_events WHERE preparation_id=%s AND action=%s ORDER BY revision
SELECT id,run_id FROM cases WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE
SELECT o.* FROM service_dispatch_offers o JOIN service_dispatch_events e ON e.offer_id=o.id WHERE o.dispatch_id=%s AND o.executor_id=%s ORDER BY e.revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT o.* FROM service_dispatch_offers o WHERE o.dispatch_id=%s AND o.executor_id=%s ORDER BY o.created_at,o.id
SELECT o.* FROM service_dispatch_offers o WHERE o.dispatch_id=%s ORDER BY o.created_at,o.id

SELECT o.*,e.revision AS acceptance_revision,e.actor_id AS acceptance_actor,
      e.payload AS acceptance_payload FROM service_dispatch_offers o JOIN service_dispatch_events e
      ON e.offer_id=o.id AND e.dispatch_id=o.dispatch_id AND e.action='ACCEPT'
      WHERE o.dispatch_id=%s AND o.state='ACCEPTED' ORDER BY e.revision DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT payload FROM service_dispatch_events WHERE offer_id=%s AND action IN ('OFFER','REOFFER') ORDER BY revision LIMIT 1
SELECT payload FROM synthetic_resource_combination_receipts WHERE combination_id=%s AND action='CONFIRM'

SELECT payload,fingerprint FROM synthetic_resource_receipts WHERE actor_id=%s AND request_key=%s UNION ALL SELECT payload,fingerprint FROM synthetic_resource_combination_receipts WHERE actor_id=%s AND request_key=%s
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(%s,0))
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended(%s,0))
SELECT preparation_id FROM service_dispatches WHERE id=%s

SELECT principal_id,capability,active,revision,xmin::text AS generation FROM capability_grants WHERE principal_id=ANY(%s) AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s AND capability IN ('READ','EXECUTE') ORDER BY principal_id,capability
SELECT principal_id,capability,active,xmin::text AS generation FROM preparation_grants WHERE principal_id=ANY(%s) AND park_id=%s AND org_id=%s ORDER BY principal_id,capability
SELECT source,xmin::text AS generation FROM preparation_catalog WHERE park_id=%s AND service_id=%s AND version=%s

SELECT starts_at,ends_at,buffer_seconds,quantity FROM synthetic_resource_holds
        WHERE resource_id=%s AND ((state='HELD' AND expires_at>%s) OR state='CONFIRMED')
        AND (%s::uuid IS NULL OR id<>%s::uuid)
        AND starts_at-make_interval(secs=>buffer_seconds)<%s
        AND ends_at+make_interval(secs=>buffer_seconds)>%s
SELECT state FROM cases WHERE id=%s
SELECT state FROM service_dispatch_offers WHERE id=%s
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s'
UPDATE controlled_plans SET invalidated_from=least(coalesce(invalidated_from,%s),%s),invalidated_at=coalesce(invalidated_at,clock_timestamp()) WHERE preparation_id=%s
UPDATE preparations SET state=%s,revision=revision+1,review_sha256=%s,material_corrections=%s WHERE id=%s RETURNING *
UPDATE service_dispatch_offers SET state=%s,receipt_step_id=%s WHERE id=%s RETURNING *
UPDATE service_dispatches SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=%s RETURNING *
UPDATE service_dispatches SET revision=revision+1,current_offer_id=%s WHERE id=%s RETURNING *
UPDATE synthetic_resource_holds SET state='CONFIRMED' WHERE id=%s
